title: Time series RNA-seq of Th1 differentiation: The effect of Progesterone on Th1 differentiation?
description: T-helper 1 responses are involved in the development of many autoimmune diseases such as Multiple sclerosis (MS). MS is a relapse remitting disease that eventually progresses to a progressive neurodegenerative disease. During pregnancy the relapse rate of MS is significantly reduced with peak reduction during the third trimester followed by an increase in relapse rate post-partum. One of the highest expressed hormones during pregnancy is progesterone. Progesterone has been show to have an inhibiting effect on T-cell activation and been proposed to promote a T-regulatory like cell state. To evaluate the influence of progesterone on the chromatin and gene expressive state of T-helper type 1 cells we differentiated primary human naïve T-cell in the presence progesterone with sampling at 0.5, 1, 2, 6 and 24 hours and performed ATAC-seq and RNA-seq.

samples.title: Th1 Progesterone 0.5h K
samples.description: Protocols: Naïve T-cells were isolated from peripheral blood mononuclear cells (PBMCs) by magnetic bead separation using a Naive CD4+ T Cell Isolation Kit II (Miltenyi Biotec). The PBMCs were isolated from the buffy coat fraction of human blood using phase separation over lymphoprep (Axis Shields). Stimulation towards Th1 differentiation for 0.5, 1, 2, 6 and 24h. Specifically the cells were treated with a 1/1 ratio of Dynabeads® Human T-Activator CD3/CD28 (Thermofisher), recombinant IL-2 (10 ng/ml), recombinant IL-12 (5 ng/ml), anti-IFNG (MAB285) (5 µg/ml) (Rnd Systems) and 50 µM Progesterone (P4) in RPMI 1640 media (Gibco). Prior to start of stimulation cells were preincubated for 12-14h with 50 µM P4. RNA was extracted using the ZR-Duet DNA/RNA Kit (Zymo Research, #D7001) and nucleic acid concentration was determined by nanodrop. RNA used for RNA sequencing underwent treatment with 5 U DNase I (Zymo Research, #E1010) in column during RNA extraction. Only RNA samples with a RNA integrity number > 7 were chosen for RNA sequencing as shown by 2100 Bioanalyzer (Agilent). Samples were processed using the TruSeq RNA Sample Prep kit (Illumina) according to the manufacturers instructions.
